text: Girls, if your creatine always ends up gritty at the bottom of your bottle, look at this. You shake it, you sip it, and the last gulp is still sand. This one is Legends. It's micronized, so it mixes right into your water. Every scoop is five grams of creatine, and there's a scoop right in the tub. No flavor, so it goes in your water or your shake. The label says it supports strength, power and workout recovery. The only problem? It's so easy, you run out of excuses to skip a day. Grab the sixty servings, so you're not out in a month. It's in the orange cart.
